comments.author: @NikolaKnezevic-r5j
comments.text: It’s not as if I’m just guessing—I was actually there in Sweden back in 1990–1991, in Märsta (on Stjärngatan Street), right near Arlanda Airport! So, I can speak with certainty, and my account definitely holds water... Swedes are a lively people—they know how to live well and please both themselves and others! Swedish women are incredibly spirited, attractive, charismatic, alluring, hot, and erotic—women who are very hard to resist! Respect, Nikola Knezevic, 59 years old (born October 25, 1967, in Belgrade, Serbia; spent the last 12 years with my family—my wife, 50, and our 15-year-old daughter—seeking asylum in Metz, France, with our status still unresolved). We wish all Swedish men and women wonderful moments and the little things that give life meaning and make it even more beautiful than usual!
